mapper.select: SELECT * FROM flashcard_deck WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flashcard_deck (user_id, deck_name, description, category, card_count, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deckName}, #{description}, #{category}, #{cardCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE flashcard_deck SET deck_name = #{deckName}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, card_count = #{cardCount}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE flashcard_deck SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
